headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth with AI driving gains for some firms while others faced modest revenue and profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY, highlighting a split between high‑growth players and mature peers. AI revenue contributions were noted at several firms, boosting margins and deal wins. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech and Wipro, indicating cautious outlooks. Profit trends were mixed, with some firms posting double‑digit jumps and others seeing declines.

themes.title: AI‑enabled revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Companies reporting AI revenue growth (Infosys, LTM, Mphasis, HCLTech, TCS) saw higher margins and larger deal wins.

themes.title: Divergent growth rates
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY revenue growth, while incumbents like Infosys and Wipro grew under 12% YoY.
